title: Fruza Mrs Blue 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Introducing Mrs Blue by Fruza Nic Salts, a classic berry and ice fusion. This flavour combines the rich, sweet notes of Blueberry, the tangy edge of Raspberry, and a hint of dark Blackcurrant. This complex berry medley is finished with a crisp, cooling ice for a refreshing all-day vape. The Fruza Nic Salts range is crafted for vapers seeking clear, intense, and authentic flavours. Inspired by Japanese precision and artistry, each 10ml e-liquid features a double concentration of flavour, designed to provide a rich and punchy taste experience. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is perfectly balanced for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It produces a discreet amount of vapour while carrying flavour exceptionally well. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit, even at higher nicotine levels, providing satisfying and rapid nicotine relief. Fruza Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20
